name: Piperazine Citrate Anhydrous
summary: According to a small computer model rather than tests on people, Piperazine Citrate Anhydrous received a low risk score of 12 for the liver [M]. The same computer model also assigned the drug a low risk score of 3 for the heart [M]. There are currently no documented safety problems, related drug issues, or FDA reports listed for this medication [1][2].
